name: Yuuki Haruna
source:
Haruna is in [url=/c1185]Kouhei's[/url] class, and is also a childhood friend of his. She has a bright personality, and enjoys helping others. [spoiler]She lost the memories from her early childhood after an accident as a child.[/spoiler]
